rte_relevantes.using_:
(is_developer() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((profiles p
     JOIN staff_schools ss ON ((ss.profile_id = p.id)))
     JOIN students st ON ((st.school_id = ss.school_id)))
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (st.id = gate_badges.student_id)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['coordinator'::account_role, 'developer'::account_role])))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.role = 'secretary'::account_role))))
